nodes.label: ArchUnit Architecture Boundary Verification
nodes.rationale: ArchUnit tests in CI enforce package-by-feature boundaries: controllers depend only on services, modules communicate via service interfaces never repos, and entities are never returned from controllers.

nodes.label: IDOR Prevention via Context Scoping
nodes.rationale: All faculty-scoped queries pull user identity directly from SecurityContext rather than request parameters, returning 404 instead of 403 on unauthorized access.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: Department-level workload makes microservices unnecessary and operationally costly; module boundaries are enforced in code so monolith remains clean.

nodes.label: FileStorage Interface
nodes.rationale: Storing files directly in PostgreSQL bloats backups and slows queries; FileStorage abstraction keeps metadata in Postgres and bytes on disk or S3 with opaque UUID keys.

nodes.label: Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) Auth Pattern
nodes.rationale: Spring Security handles OIDC with Entra ID, manages server-side sessions, and issues HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookies; SPA never holds tokens, preventing token exposure.
